title: Signal: Dynamic SQL executed from text (mysql) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on dynamic SQL execution in mysql code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any dynamic execution form matches, including constant statements.

examples.line: PREPARE stmt FROM CONCAT('SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = ', @id);
# audit: PREPARE stmt FROM CONCAT('SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = ', @id); present
PREPARE stmt FROM 'SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = ?';
# verified: PREPARE stmt FROM 'SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = ?';

fpNotes: A constant statement text assembled from fixed identifiers is the common false positive.
